zh.explain: 抱柴草去救火，会燃得更旺，甚至会无止尽地燃烧。如果要问荣华富贵和出入是否平安，不如收起自己的枉然心机。
divination: 即使有很多好的选择，也不如保持现状，否则一旦变化，恐怕要惹祸上身。
zh.summary: 此卦抱薪救火之象。所祈求之事还需自己小心谨慎防护。

verse: Add fuel to a fire and now it burns more fiercely,
The bright flames spread for miles, sparing nothing.
On the pursuits of riches and fame,
Why not save the trouble and forget?
interpretation: Why bother with so many schemes, why not let things remain?
Doing too much may someday inevitably create problems that will be hard to get rid of.
meaning: Trying to extinguish a fire with firewood.
You must take precautions to protect yourself.
en.explain: When you carry firewood to put out a fire, it will burn more fiercely, and even burn endlessly. If you are asking about wealth, fame and safe passage wherever you go, you might as well put away your scheming efforts.
divination: Even if you have many good choices, it is better to maintain the status quo.
Otherwise, you may get into trouble once changes occur.

notes: Extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en divination: 'Otherwise...' starts on a new line in the image, kept as separate entry.
